name: default-slider
title: Default Image Slider
description: A wide image slider showing four portrait photos one at a time, with faint round side arrows and dash dots below. It stops at the first and last slide instead of looping.
use: A large photo should lead the page and users page through a fixed set.
avoid: No looping, so the last slide dead-ends unless the developer turns loop on.
a11y: Alts are generic ("Nature slide 1") and arrow buttons have no accessible names. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide photo frame showing a close-up of a woman's face through pale fabric against a blue sky, with thin dark bands above and below. A row of small dash dots sits at the bottom centre and a faint round arrow appears at each side.
behaves: The picture slides horizontally between four photos when an arrow or dot is clicked, and stops at the first and last rather than wrapping. The active dash darkens and side arrows fade at the ends.
customise: The four image URLs are hardcoded; height, arrow styling and dot look come from classes you can copy or edit.
weight: light: Four remote photos with embla scrolling; nothing loops.
demo: Close-up portraits of a woman in a veil against blue sky
issues: The alt text says nature, but the slides are portraits of a person.
The arrows sit faintly at the frame edges and are easy to miss.
polishWhy: Simple, legible slider; generic alts and faint controls make it a standard pick.
